name: Acute Otitis Media and Otitis Media with Effusion

reference.source: Dhingra Diseases of ENT 8th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Bulging drum diagnoses AOM; red drum alone does not
Glue ear: watch three months before grommets
Unilateral effusion in adult equals nasopharynx examination
Analgesia is treatment for every child with AOM
reference.pathophysiology: Viral upper airway inflammation swells the Eustachian tube, trapping bacteria in middle ear fluid under pressure. Effusion persists when tube dysfunction keeps the ear under-ventilated after infection or from adenoid obstruction.
